input cin;

wire gnd;
wire vcc;

assign gnd = 1'b0;
assign vcc = 1'b1;

assign sum = a ^ b ^ cin;     // sum calculation
assign cout = (a & b) | (cin & (a ^ b)); // carry out calculation
